channel.title: New Zealand Parliament - Proposed Bills and Inquiries
channel.description: Proposed laws, Select Committee inquiries, and submission openings

item.title: Health and Disability Services (System Oversight and Standards) Amendment Bill
item.description: The Social Services and Community Committee invites public submissions on the Health and Disability Services Amendment Bill. The bill introduces mandatory quality reporting standards, clinical risk governance frameworks, and independent evaluation mandates for contracted community providers.

item.title: Inquiry into Crown-Māori Environmental Co-governance and Consenting Frameworks
item.description: The Environment Select Committee has initiated a nationwide inquiry into iwi and hapū participation in natural resource consenting and Treaty partnership outcomes across regional councils.
